name: Domestic Intrusion
core_tension: A familiar private space becomes inadequate as an irreversible transformation changes the body's scale and relation to the room.
signals: furniture or architecture becomes a scale reference
witness or second character may be present
counter_signals: space is already an experimental containment environment

name: Institutional / Experimental Containment
core_tension: A controlled institution attempts to contain, measure, or direct a transformation that exceeds its intended limits.
counter_signals: setting is primarily domestic without institutional framing

name: Triggered Metamorphosis
core_tension: A causal event converts an ordinary baseline into a prolonged transformation with consequences.
counter_signals: transformation has no identifiable onset or trigger

name: Remake / Refinement Loop
core_tension: A stable scenario or premise is revisited while execution, duration, animation, simulation, camera, or sound is refined.
signals: earlier and later media both available
counter_signals: similar title without evidence of a remake relationship

name: Escalation Without Closure
core_tension: The transformation itself remains the payoff; the ending preserves extreme scale or ongoing change rather than resolving into a conventional final form.
counter_signals: a clearly resolved final form and conventional closure
